description.narrative: The Korean government via the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries would like to prepare a green ODA project in the maritime sector and asked GGGI for the preparation of a PCP.The project aims to support 2 Pacific Island Countries in decarbonizing their maritime transport/port sector. Possible ComponentsRegulatory Framework/RoadmapPre-FS Alternative Maritime Power (AMP) Energy Distribution Technology (Electric Vessel etc) and/or Port Management SystemPilot ProjectCapacity BuildingTimeline: Prepare Project Concept Paper until Mid Feb, Ministry Ocean and Fisheries – will send to Ministry of Foreign Affairs (March-May review) and then Ministry of Finance (May-June review), results in August/September 2023.Aiming for 2 countries: Fiji + 1 country from this list (https://www.bie-paris.org/site/en/the-member-states), potentially Vanuatu.
